versions.content: The visibility state shall be set by calling the interface Dem_SetDTR. If Dem_SetDTR is called with Dem_DTRControlType set to DEM_DTR_CTL_INVISIBLE the DTR state is set to "invisible". If Dem_SetDTR is called with any other defined Dem_DTRCon- trolType (DEM_DTR_CTL_NORMAL, DEM_DTR_CTL_NO_MAX, DEM_DTR_CTL_NO_- MIN, DEM_DTR_CTL_RESET) the DTR state is set to "visible".
